QUOTE: It is not retried automatically... `client.createPost` passes `noRetry: true` (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:46`), which sets `retryLimit: 0`... So a failed send gets one attempt and no automatic resend.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the create-post request is sent once with no automatic retry, naming the noRetry mechanism.
